intent: Let the owner skip a required interview stage if they write why.

edit.summary:
I changed the `skip_stage` action in `authoring/authoring.domain.yaml`. Its description used to say it only covered an optional stage. It now says the owner can skip a stage, optional or required, and must write the reason.

The action already had the pieces the request needs. Only the owner can use it, and it requires a person. It also has a required `reason` parameter, so I left those alone.

I set the action's status to `proposed` instead of `confirmed`. The original confirmation covered the old meaning, so this change needs fresh confirmation.

I didn't bump the file's `version: 17`. I also can't tell from the files whether the kernel itself refuses to skip required stages. If it does, this declaration change won't be enough on its own.
